lines.trans: You are completely mad, Noemie!
Yes, I am mad about you!
You make me laugh so much.
We are starting a new life together.
You left the agency for me.
I would follow you everywhere in Paris.
We will be free with our company.
You will be a very powerful producer.
And you will be my closest ally.
I will always be by your side.
Nothing can stop us now.
Kiss me tenderly in this taxi.
This is the beginning of our triumph.
I love you with all my heart.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Il arrête de travailler à six heures.
Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Elles commencent avec un peu de Botox.
examples.trans: They start with a bit of Botox.

meanings.en: commencer par / avec: to start with

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!
Il y a un côté positif.

meanings.note: un côté positif: a bright side

examples.text: Ça va lui briser le cœur.
examples.trans: It's going to break her heart.

meanings.en: briser le cœur = to break someone's heart

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: It's the start of the film.

meanings.note: au début = at first, at the beginning

examples.trans: Love (at the end of a letter or call).

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Elle est libre dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: at liberty; not 'free of charge' (that's gratuit)
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
before the noun; nouvel before a vowel

examples.text: C'est impossible de travailler avec un bébé partout.
examples.trans: It's impossible to work with a baby everywhere.

meanings.note: pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

meanings.en: to leave someone, to break up with
meanings.note: elle m'a quitté = she left me
in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien
argent de la société = company's money
tu me suis? = are you following me?
prendre un taxi / monter dans le taxi

examples.trans: We're going to call a taxi.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
c'est tellement stupide = it's so stupid
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: Le film est un grand triomphe.
examples.trans: The movie is a great triumph.

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
